spans.s:
Arbuda is mentioned as Grāvastut priest at the snake festival described in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa. He is obviously the same mythical figure as arbuda Kādraveya, a seer spoken of in the aitareya and kauṣītaki Brāhmaṇas as a maker of Mantras.
